title: SpellDirector effect template
description: A director-written recipe for a spell effect. A renderer turns template + seed into frames. See docs/template-format.md.

line.description: Optional spell line (class, school or skill line) the spell belongs to, e.g. "Bard", "Necromancer". The viewer can group spells by it.

archetype.description: strike, projectile, chain, beam, aura or nova; status: a lingering affliction on one target (burning, frozen, asleep) that applies, loops while it lasts (timing.loop_range) and expires.

reference.description: File name or URL of the reference GIF, if any.

loop_range.description: An aura's sustain section: the frames from start_ms to end_ms loop seamlessly for as long as the aura lasts (start-up before, end after).

layout.description: chain (default): targets strung out in the footprint, hit in turn. splash: one primary target the caster picks, with the rest standing round it within radius; layers anchored at "splash" repeat on each of them.

radius.description: splash: how far round the primary target the other enemies stand, in world units (1 = one character height).

ripple_ms.description: splash: a splash target's layers start this many ms later per world unit of distance from the primary target (default 120; 0 = all at once).

order.description: splash: ripple (default) delays each splash target by its distance from the primary; sequence hits them one after another, hop_delay_ms apart, going round the primary (a ricochet). sweep: each is hit as a blade sweeping round the centre reaches them (sweep_ms per turn from sweep_start_deg): a whirlwind, a wide cleave.

side.description: splash: who stands round the centre. enemies (default) or allies (a rallying shout, a battle-fury aura: blue stand-ins with a green ring).

react.description: How each target reacts, starting at_ms plus its splash delay. A list plays several, each from its own at_ms (a flinch for every hit of a combo, then a knockback).

sweep_ms.description: order sweep: ms the sweep takes per full turn (default 600; negative = the other way round, from +Z toward -Z).

sweep_start_deg.description: order sweep: where the sweep starts, degrees from the cast direction, positive toward +Z (the caster's off-hand side). Default -90: the casting hand's side.

caster_react.description: How the caster's body moves (shout: rear back, then shout; lunge, leap, spin for weapon skills). A list plays several together, each from its own at_ms (a lunge, then a spin).

caster_gestures.description: The caster's arm and hand movements, in order: raise, throw, push palm-out, point a finger, slam, roar... Anchors on the hands (caster_hand, caster_fingertip, ...) follow them. See docs/template-format.md#gestures.

caster_clip.description: A Mixamo-style animation clip (spelldirector.clip/1, converted in the viewer from a Mixamo FBX or GLB and kept in the library's clips/ folder) that drives the caster's arms, hands and fingers while it plays, blended in from and back out to caster_gestures. Hand anchors follow it. Without the clip loaded, the gestures play. See docs/template-format.md#mixamo-clips.

clip.description: The clip's name: its file name in clips/ without .json.

at_ms.description: When the clip starts (spell time). Default 0.

from_ms.description: Where in the clip to start (skip a wind-up). Default 0.

to_ms.description: Where in the clip to stop. Default its end.

speed.description: Playback speed (2 = twice as fast). Default 1.

mirror.description: Play it on the other side: a right-handed Mixamo throw thrown with the casting (left, lead) hand. Default false.

blend_ms.description: How long it blends in before at_ms and back out after it ends. Default 150.

hold_ms.description: How long the clip's last pose holds before it blends out. Default 0.

caster_weapon.description: A weapon held in the caster's lead hand (a crude stand-in): the casting hand rests holding it up in guard, sword gestures swing it, slash layers trace it, and the anchors caster_blade and caster_blade_tip ride on it. See docs/template-format.md#sword-skills.

kind.description: sword (default length 50 px), greatsword (74 px, wider), dagger (24 px), maul (a two-handed hammer: a 66 px haft with a heavy iron head at its end; caster_blade sits in the head).

length_px.description: Blade length instead of the kind's own.

views.description: How the effect reads from each standard camera. Every template is authored in 3D so all four views render from the same data. See docs/vocabulary.md#camera-views.

hero.description: The view the effect is designed to look best from (usually the game's camera).

front.description: What the player should see in the front view.

side.description: What the player should see in the side view.

top.description: What the player should see in the top view.

three_quarter.description: What the player should see in the three_quarter view.

frame.description: How the viewer frames the spell. close: a small effect on one character (a buff) fills the frame, head to toe plus what floats over the head. Default auto.

readability.description: How the spell should read on screen: the distance it is judged at, the camera distances to check, the must-read cues and the key frames that set the quality target. tools/range_guide.py measures and draws it. See docs/template-format.md#readability.

reference_distance.description: World units (1 = a character's height) the look is judged at. Default: space.footprint.length (or radius).

view_distances.description: Camera distances in world units to check the spell at (default 3, 6, 12, 20).

cue.description: What the player must see, in a few words (the hand-to-jet connection).

layers.description: The layers that carry the cue.

beat.description: The beat it must read in (default: the spell's peak).

at_ms.description: The moment it must read at (default: the middle of its beat, else the spell's peak).

measure.description: What to measure: thickness across the cast direction (the median along it), start (thickness where it leaves the caster, so a gap at the hand shows), the hot core's thickness, or the overall size. Default: thickness for long shapes, else size.

note.description: What the frame must show (the quality target).

key_frames.description: Moments to judge the quality target by (ignition, first contact, shutdown). Default: the start of the first release and impact beats and partway into the first dissipation beat.

style.description: The art style this template is meant for (the viewer and export can switch to any other). See docs/template-format.md#style and docs/vocabulary.md section 12.

preset.description: stylized (default): saturated, soft, strong bloom. realistic: lit, depth decals, heat haze, filmic. toon: cel bands and ink outlines. pixel: low-res pixel art.

depth.description: How deep carved decals look in the realistic style, default 0.6.

saturation.description: Color saturation in the viewer for this preset (1 = as authored).

bloom.description: Multiplier on the preset's bloom strength.

notes.description: What the style should feel like for this spell, for the engine artist.

intent.description: Plain-language note on what this beat should feel like.

beats.description: Beat ids this layer is active in.

plane.description: How the layer sits in 3D, which decides how it looks in each view. Defaults per layer type are in docs/template-format.md.

attach_to.description: Another layer this one follows (e.g. glow around a bolt).

z.description: Draw order; higher is in front.

tracking.description: How the layer moves when the actor it sits on moves. follow: rides on its anchor (local space). trail: the emitter follows but each particle stays where it was emitted (world-space particles: embers, smoke). stay: placed once where its anchor was and left there (a scorch mark). Default: decals and eruptions stay, free sparks and smoke trail, everything else follows. See docs/template-format.md#readability.

shape.description: What the mark looks like from above. See docs/template-format.md#decals.

radius_px.description: Radius of the mark at full size (100 px = one character height).

fade_in_ms.description: Fade in from the start of its first beat, default 60.

lifetime_ms.description: How long it stays at full strength from its start (default: until its last beat ends). May run past the spell's end: the mark stays on the ground.

fade_ms.description: Fade out after the lifetime, default 400.

grow_ms.description: Grow from start_scale to full size over this long (0 = appear at full size).

rotation_deg.description: Angle on the ground, counter-clockwise from the cast direction. Omit for a random angle per cast.

stretch.description: Length along its rotation axis relative to its width, default 1.

detail.description: How busy the texture is (cracks, rays, glyphs), default 0.5.

arc_deg.description: Keep only the sector facing the cast direction, this many degrees wide (default 360: the whole mark). Without a rotation_deg, an arc mark faces the cast direction.

reveal_ms.description: The mark spreads out from its centre over this long from its start, like cracks running across the ground (default 0: appears whole).

depth.description: How carved the mark looks with depth (realistic): 1 deep, 0 flat, negative raised. Default per shape.

fill.description: What sits in the bottom of the mark: lava, glow (energy light), liquid (water, blood), void (darkness). Default none.

fill_color.description: Palette slot of the fill. Default: lava gradient_core_to_primary, glow the layer's color, liquid primary, void shadow.

fill_flow.description: How fast the fill flows (1 = default).

fill_in_ms.description: Time for the fill to rise into the mark from its start, default 200.

radius.description: How far it reaches, in world units (1 = one character height), default 6.

height_px.description: Height above the ground, default 80; negative = under the ground (an under light).

forward_px.description: Offset from the anchor along the cast direction (negative = behind it), default 0.

side_px.description: Offset from the anchor to the side, positive = left of the cast direction, default 0.

orbit_hz.description: Turns per second it circles the anchor at its forward/side distance (counter-clockwise seen from above; negative = clockwise), default 0.

tint.description: A light color outside the palette (#RRGGBB), e.g. neon stage or rim lights. Overrides the layer's color slot.

along.description: With attach_to a beam: where on the beam the light sits, 0 = the hand, 1 = the target (default 0.5).

along_swing.description: With attach_to a beam: how far (in beam lengths) the light slides back and forth around `along` (default 0).

along_hz.description: With attach_to a beam: slides per second (default 1).

shape.description: What the motif is (banner: a war banner on a pole). See docs/template-format.md#motifs.

count.description: How many items, evenly spaced round the orbit.

tints.description: Per-item colors, cycled (a ring of different gems).

face.description: Turn each item along its orbit or outward.

emblem.description: banner only: the device on the cloth, in the core color.

wave.description: banner only: how hard the cloth ripples (0 hangs still, 1 a stiff wind; default 0.5).

params.description: Layer parameters. Any value may be a number, a {min,max} range (picked per cast from the seed), a boolean, a short enum string or a list of #RRGGBB colors (a motif's per-item tints). Known keys per layer type are listed in docs/template-format.md.

shader.description: Shader intent: how an engine should build this layer's look with shaders and particles. A description, not pixels. See docs/vocabulary.md section 11.

material.description: What the layer is made of; sets the overall feel.

look.description: One sentence on what the shader should feel like.

technique.description: How to build it in an engine.

scale.description: Noise cells per character height (1 world unit). Small = broad blobs, large = fine grain.

speed.description: How fast the noise moves or evolves, in world units per second.
UV scroll / flow speed in world units per second.

distortion.description: Refraction or heat-haze strength behind the layer (0 none, 1 strong).

fresnel.description: Rim brightness at grazing angles (0 none, 1 strong edge glow).

edge_color.description: Palette slot for the burning edge.

dissolve.description: How the layer erodes away as it fades, instead of a plain fade.

hdr.description: Brightness multiplier into bloom: 1 = no bloom, 2-4 glowing, 5-10 blinding.

core_ratio.description: How much of the width is the white-hot core.

lighting.description: unlit: draws its own light; lit: shaded by the scene's lights; emits_light: also lights the scene; six_way: smoke relit from six baked directions (six-way lightmaps), see docs/vocabulary.md#six-way-lit-smoke.

volumetric.description: The layer must read as a body with real depth and thickness from every angle (front, side, top, 3/4), not a flat card or strip: crossed or camera-facing layers, an inner core inside a softer outer shell, edges faded by fresnel and noise, soft particles. See docs/vocabulary.md#volumetric.

styles.description: Per-style refinements of this shader intent (merged over it when the spell is built in that style), e.g. a realistic look sentence or material.

reaction.description: How a stand-in figure reacts (the viewer poses it; an engine plays a hit reaction or animation). See docs/template-format.md#warcries.

kind.description: knockback: shoved back off their feet and stays pushed. flinch: rocked back and upright again. cower: crouched, leaning away and trembling, then straightening. cheer: hopping on the spot. shout: the caster rears back and throws the chest forward. lunge: a step in toward the centre (the caster: forward) and back. leap: up and in in an arc, landing crouched. spin: whole turns on the spot (turns).

at_ms.description: When it starts (targets: plus their splash delay).

distance_px.description: knockback: how far they are pushed away from the centre (default 90). lunge, leap: how far they step or jump in (45, 80).

lift_px.description: cheer: hop height (default 14). leap: jump height (default 45).

turns.description: spin: how many whole turns (default 1; negative = clockwise seen from above).

gesture.description: One casting gesture. Its last key lands at at_ms + duration_ms (the release of a throw); it holds for hold_ms, then the arms ease back to rest over return_ms unless the next gesture takes over.

kind.description: One-handed: raise, point, push, throw, spin_throw, sky_point, sign, channel, hold_orb (rest returns that arm to rest). Two-handed: raise_both, push_both, channel_both, gather, summon, slam, clap, roar, flex, ground_press, guard, flail, cheer. Sword strokes (the blade rides in the lead hand with space.caster_weapon): slash (wound back on the lead side, swept across the front; the blade crosses the front at about 75%), backslash (the return sweep), chop (overhead, down), rising_slash (low to high), thrust (drawn back to the hip, stabbed forward), blade_out (arm and blade held straight out to the side, for a spin); two-handed: cleave (a two-handed overhead chop), sweep_both (both hands on the grip, blade held out to the side).

duration_ms.description: How long until its last key (default per kind).

hand.description: One-handed gestures: lead (default, the casting hand at caster_hand), off, or both (mirrored).

hold_ms.description: How long the end pose holds (default 250).

return_ms.description: How long the arms take to ease back to rest (default 400).

shape.description: The hand shape at the end, instead of the gesture's own.
